name: web-breadcrumb-pill-with-home-icon-and-chevron-separators
title: Rounded breadcrumb pill 'Home > Profile > Settings' with a house icon, grey parents and a black current page
whatItIs: A white frame with a thin-bordered capsule containing a house icon, a chevron, a grey 'Profile', another chevron and a black 'Settings'.
whatItMeans: Understated and clear; contrast alone marks the current page.
techniques: Put the path in a rounded capsule.
Use a house icon for the root.
Grey the parents and black the current.

vocabulary.definition: A trail showing where you are in a hierarchy.
The last crumb, shown in stronger colour.
A house icon standing for Home.
